## 2024-05-18 - Tooltips Enhancement
**Learning:** Adding helpful `help` tooltips to standard form components (like input fields and dropdowns) natively generated by Streamlit is a quick micro-UX enhancement pattern that makes the interface more intuitive.
**Action:** Always add descriptive `help` attributes to `st.text_input` and `st.selectbox` components to improve UX without needing full visual regression tests since it's a native Streamlit feature.
